newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Carnarvon issues 20 mln shares at discount.
newsitem.headline: Carnarvon issues 20 mln shares at discount.

text.p: Carnarvon Petroleum NL said on Wednesday it has placed 20 million shares to two clients of broker Hartley Poynton Ltd at an issue price of two cents.
Carnarvon shares were one cent higher at 25 cents at 11.40 a.m. (0140 GMT). It has 442.4 million shares on issue.

The capital raised by the placement will be used as working capital, including a planned drilling programme in EP-342, particularly a possible transaction involving the acquisition of an interest in a petroleum exploration permit, the company said.
The permit is the site of the Leatherback oilfield in Western Australia. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
